verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents giving each agent its own unique digital identity (auth0-docs-20). It backs this with Machine-to-Machine applications that authenticate via their own client ID and secret through the Client Credentials flow, so agents do not use a user's login (auth0-docs-8, auth0-docs-54). Permissions can be narrowed with scopes and granular permissions for M2M communications, and agent access is described as fine-grained rather than broad (auth0-docs-81, auth0-docs-16, auth0-docs-68). Missing for 10: any evidence of instant credential or token revocation for an agent identity, and independent or hands-on confirmation of per-agent least-privilege setups.
